Name: Donkey over Horse
Author: atyfaz
Description: This is a mod I made a really long time ago but never uploaded publically. I figured, hey why not update it for the newest version of SDV really quick and upload it too while I'm at it. I've included downloads for the original that works for Content Patcher format 1.14.0 (basically it should work for any and all versions of SDV with the horse [i]before[/i] carrots were added into the game, as well as the newest version with Content Patcher format 2.7.0 and should work for any and all versions of the games with the current horse sprite sheet with the chewing carrots sprites on them. As long as new updates to the horse sprite sheet aren't made, it should continue working for all versions.

Downloads.Description: This is the version that will work for all version from 1.6 forward (so long as they don't change the base horse sprite sheet in the future). Content Patcher and SMAPI are required.
